desc: Derive correct approach: S_t telescoping formula answer = S_0 - sum_{t>=1} S_t/2^t with 2^t | S_t; verified on sample 1 (36-18-9-3-1=5) and hand-checked small cases
Derive residue-class formula for S_t: diagonal classes r=0 and r=M/2 contribute (c_r+1)*v_r; cross pairs r<M/2<s=M-r contribute v_r*c_s + v_s*c_r; verified on examples
Establish bounds: max sum 2e7 < 2^25 so only t=1..24 needed; int64 overflow analysis OK (max ~4e17); memory plan: bincount for t<=22 (~68MB peak), dict/Counter for t=23,24
Implement solve() with numpy: read stdin, compute S_0=(N+1)*sum(A), loop t=1..22 with bincount, t=23,24 with Counter pair-sum counting, output S_0 - sum(S_t >> t)
Validate implementation against all three samples (expected 5, 384, 20241214) and edge cases (N=1, all equal values, powers of two sums)
